description: Fictional world modelled on late-Tang (9th century) warlord-period Chinese cities. Canon is encoded as propositional constraints over entity types; each rule is independently machine-checkable.

example_constraints: City is walled; the warlord's residence (ya-cheng) sits inside the inner compound
Markets are spatially bounded and time-regulated under the fang-shi system

timeline.description: Reign eras, events with absolute and relative dates
example_constraints: No technology may be referenced whose historical first use postdates the scenario year
Events must respect recorded causal order of the era

faction.description: Warlord houses, court, merchants, religious institutions
example_constraints: A faction may only trade goods its era and territory permit
Post-Huichang (845 CE) monastery construction and ordination are state-controlled

design_rule.description: Codified historical design knowledge, encoded as checkable propositions
example_constraints: Required-presence rules (e.g. tea culture present, woodblock printing available)

notes: required_terms rules are defined but not yet enforced by the v0.1 checker (absence is context-dependent).
Scope fields map to asset-description fields: food, goods, structures, props, tech, transport, institutions.
